name: SOCAR Inc.
summary: Socar, Inc. engages in the development and provision of a mobile car sharing application. It operates through the Car Sharing Sector and Platform Sector divisions. The Car Sharing Sector division refers to non-face-to-face short-term car sharing service. The Platform Sector division relates to the electric bike sharing service. The company was founded on October 31, 2011 and is headquartered in Jeju-si, South Korea.
